_note: Lead Suite Evidence settings. This repo is PUBLIC: no names, no phone numbers, no money amounts here. Change a value and the next run uses it. Every block says where its values come from.

contract._source: Lead Suite contract, signed 2026-07-19 (private copy in the vault, Ads Agency folder). The fee is refunded if Surven gets fewer than the target number of booked qualified calls within the window after ads go live, and only with CRM proof that every lead was contacted and qualified with their scored checklist.

ads._source: Ads went live 2026-08-08 (the first ad lead came in that day). They were paused 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-24 (both days included). Lead Suite's CSM said the pause does not burn the 90-day clock, so paused days are skipped when the window end is worked out.

pauses._source: CSM message: the pause does not burn the clock. Keep that message in the refund file, because the ad spend condition says 90 days in a row.

portal._source: The Lead Suite portal has no API. Joey types one row per lead (+ Add Lead) and one per booked call (+ Add Call), on Sundays.
portal._entered_through_note: Optional. An Eastern date like "2026-11-01". Leads that came in, and calls that happened, on or before this date count as already typed into the portal. The page also remembers which rows it listed before (from the last published page), so this is only needed after a missed week or on the first run.

sop._source: Lead Suite's scored per-lead checklist (portal, checked 2026-07-23): triple dial within 3 to 5 min of the form fill, SMS 1 within 5 min, double dial right after a reply, SMS 2 at plus 3 to 4 hours, SMS 3 at plus 2 to 3 hours after SMS 2, lead replied. The booked call checklist: triage call before the main call, show-rate SOP followed, pre-call video email the evening before, morning confirm call or text, showed. The texts stop once the lead replies (official Show Rate SOP, CSM Loom 2026-07-24).
sop._double_dial_note: The SOP says right after the reply. 10 minutes is our reading of that. Change it here if Lead Suite says otherwise.
sop._words_note: Auto-dialer calls often have no length in GHL. Their length is estimated from the transcript word count, the same way the Morning Sales Brief does it.
sop._dial_note: A canceled call is the bridge that rang Joey first and never reached the lead, so it is not a dial.

quiet_hours._source: Show Up Machine quiet hours (8am to 8:45pm in the lead's time zone). A text or double dial that falls in quiet hours is due at 8am.

sop._next_day_note: The CSM's ruling (GHL setup call, 2026-07-24): a form filled after about 9pm on the lead's clock gets its first call the next morning in work hours. So a lead who comes in after 9pm, or before 8am, starts the clock at 8am. A lead who comes in before 9pm is due right away.
sop._morning_note: Morning confirm: a call or text on the morning of the call (lead's clock), from 5am until noon or the call start, whichever comes first, and at least 30 minutes after the booking. A call booked the same day after that morning has no morning, so the box is Not due.

calls._source: Same rules as the Morning Sales Brief: the Discovery Call calendar counts; the Lead Suite calendar is a Google Calendar copy, so only its events titled as a discovery call count, and a copy within 30 minutes of a Discovery Call booking is the same call. Onboarding and go-live calls are client calls, never sales calls. A booking canceled and rebooked within 60 minutes is one booking.
calls._count_rule_note: booked_at: a call counts when it was booked inside the window. start: when it happens inside the window.

qualified._source: A booked call counts as qualified unless GHL marks the lead unqualified: the Leadsuite Pipeline stage, or the STL Outcome Reason (convention since 2026-08-08: Not Qualified or Disqualified carries the truth). Overrides are keyed by the lead's reply code only, never a name.

exclude._source: GHL contact ids to leave out of the evidence. Ids only, never names. v0m9gv4y7LiIYire4SAf is Joey's second own contact in Surven HQ (calls he books in Google Calendar land on it; same list as the Morning Sales Brief). Also left out on their own: Joey's alert contact (config/surven.json), contacts tagged svn-test, svn-tooltest, test-contact-delete-me or owner-joey, contacts with the Test Contact field set, and any contact with the same phone, email or full name as a GHL user of the location (a team member's own test).
